description: Transactions near day/month boundaries to test timezone handling. bizDate (authoritative user-tz date) differs from UTC-occurredAt month: TX1 is at 2026-08-31T16:00Z = 2026-09-01 in Shanghai (UTC says Aug, Shanghai says Sep); TX2 is at 2026-09-30T16:00Z = 2026-10-01 in Shanghai (UTC says Sep, Shanghai says Oct). bizDate matches Shanghai-local date in both cases. Two distinct grouping results: bizDate and Shanghai-occurredAt produce identical monthly groupings (Sep: TX1+TX3, Oct: TX2); UTC-occurredAt differs (Aug: TX1, Sep: TX2+TX3).

transactions.note: UTC Aug 31 16:00 = Shanghai Sep 1 00:00 (bizDate authoritative = Shanghai date)
UTC Sep 30 16:00 = Shanghai Oct 1 00:00 (bizDate authoritative = Shanghai date)
